commands.environment: TEMP and TMP point to target/test-tmp

coverage: A reconciled OKX or Bitget native OCO may route cancellation of its single active child through the ordinary CCXT order-cancel path.

The active child's persisted remote order ID must match a numeric EventLog identity; the opposite leg must be terminal with zero fill; the group must be Active or PartiallyFilled and not behind a reconciliation barrier.
The cancellation result is synchronized back into the persisted order-group snapshot; snapshot persistence failures fence the group for reconciliation.
Ambiguous group membership, remote identity, peer state, or fill state remains rejected and fail-closed.
scope_limitations: This is local Rust service test evidence. No OKX or Bitget private API was called, no order was placed or canceled, and no sandbox or production behavior was verified.
The new commit's GitHub Actions CI and public-data quickstart runs were still in progress when this record was written.
The feature remains implemented-unverified for both exchanges until authorized venue-specific lifecycle acceptance is completed.
